name: ToolbarButton

component.name: ToolbarButton
component.description: Styled native button with active, tone, size, and full-width options. Forwards a button ref and native button props.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Renders custom content before children. When omitted, a default placeholder icon is rendered before children. Pass renderContent={() => null} to show only children.

props.name: children
props.description: Standard children, rendered after renderContent output.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the button.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Additional native button attributes, including aria-* and data-*.

props.name: tone
props.description: Visual color treatment of the button.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands the button to fill its container width.

accessibilityAttributes: Defaults to type="button"; an explicit native type prop can override it.
Pass an accessible name using aria-label or visible text. Native aria-* and data-* props are forwarded.

behavior: Outside ZoomUIToolkitProvider or ThemeProvider, the button uses the dark theme.
